preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m are integers between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= val <= 1023 for row in matrix for val in row)
preconditions.description: All matrix elements are non-negative integers not exceeding 1023.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix has exactly n rows, each containing exactly m integers.

postconditions.expression: if not exists_valid_selection: output_lines[0] == 'NIE' and len(output_lines) == 1 else output_lines[0] == 'TAK' and len(output_lines) == 2
postconditions.description: If no valid selection exists, output 'NIE' on a single line; otherwise, output 'TAK' followed by a second line with indices.

postconditions.expression: if output_lines[0] == 'TAK': all(1 <= idx <= m for idx in indices) and len(indices) == n
postconditions.description: When 'TAK' is printed, the second line contains exactly n integers, each representing a valid 1-based column index between 1 and m.
When 'TAK' is printed, the bitwise XOR sum of the selected elements (using 0-based indexing for the matrix) is strictly greater than zero.
When 'NIE' is printed, there truly exists no sequence of column indices such that the XOR sum of the selected elements is greater than zero.
